item.title: Job seekers are using ‘résumé Botox’ to seem younger. They say it helped them land interviews
item.description: Nearly half of those surveyed say they’ve manipulated their résumés or LinkedIn profiles to hide their age from employers, and they’re using AI to do it. Where cosmetic Botox softens wrinkles, so-called “résumé Botox” does the same for job seekers’ applications, making them appear younger to prospective employers. That might mean removing or editing graduation years, early jobs, senior titles, and profile photos, all in the service of obscuring an applicant’s real age....
